operator_io_quirks: Mixed-case identifiers: table 'game', columns 'Home_Games','Average_Attendance','Total_Attendance','Capacity_Percentage','Season','Date','Home_team','Away_team','Score','Competition','Number_of_matches','Player','Injury','Source' — must be double-quoted verbatim; case-insensitive lookup.
Column named 'Date' (declared TEXT) and 'Season' (INT) — 'Date' is a reserved-ish word, quote it; 'Season' holds years 2007-2011.
FKs are declared with backtick-quoted parent: references `stadium`("id") — pragma foreign_key_list still resolves; parent_exists true for both.
All columns notnull=0, no CHECK, no UNIQUE beyond PKs; single-column PKs on all three tables (id).
Tiny tables (13/20/15 rows) — no sampling cap needed; original_values fully read.
Text-stored dates in 'Date': format 'D Month YYYY' e.g. '18 May 2007','22 September 2007','9 December 2007' — no leading zero on day, full month name.
Text-stored numbers: 'Number_of_matches' TEXT holding '12','2','1' (int-like strings); 'Score' TEXT holding en-dash '1–1','0–0 (7:6)' (U+2013, not ASCII hyphen).
Non-ASCII in text: 'Dejan Stanković' (ć), en-dash in Score — sqlite text storage, fine.
Constant columns: stadium.Home_Games all '8' (distinct=1); injury_accident.Source all 'inter.it' (distinct=1) — String fuzzer will still contaminate.
Capacity_Percentage real >100 (108.8) — no range constraint; Number fuzzer full range [-10^scale,10^scale] with scale from REAL (no args -> default).
REAL columns store as 'real' storage class; INT columns as 'integer'; no storage/declared contradictions.
FK child columns (game.stadium_id, injury_accident.game_id) have distinct < parent rows (12<13, 11<20) — some parents unreferenced; no NULLs.
operator_ts_expectations: stadium.id, game.id, injury_accident.id: Number fuzzer, single-col PK -> max_l0=inf, int perturb +-1/+-2; fresh draws dominate -> many implausible large ids but PK uniqueness enforced by sample_fresh_primary_keys.

stadium.name, game.Home_team/Away_team/Competition, injury_accident.Player/Injury/Source: String fuzzer, length range from originals, 50% contaminate -> random charset strings mixed with real names; drives FN when queries filter on real team names ('Pakhtakor') or 'League'.
game.Date declared TEXT -> String fuzzer (NOT Date fuzzer, since type has no 'date'): produces random strings, not 'D Month YYYY' — any date-format query (strftime, LIKE '%2007%') will miss -> FN.
game.Score TEXT -> String fuzzer: en-dash '1–1' treated as opaque string; queries parsing score (split on '-') get garbage -> FN.
injury_accident.Number_of_matches TEXT -> String fuzzer: int-like strings get +-1 neighbors added to elements, but fresh random strings dominate -> numeric comparisons (CAST, >) miss -> FN.

stadium.Home_Games (distinct=1, '8') and injury_accident.Source (distinct=1): String/Number fuzzer with 1 element -> p effectively 1, mostly returns the single element perturbed; queries 'WHERE Home_Games=8' may still pass, but 'Source=inter.it' with contamination (50%) breaks -> FN.

stadium.Average_Attendance/Total_Attendance/Capacity_Percentage REAL -> Number fuzzer scale default (no args -> scale 0? type 'real' has no parens): full range [-1,1] or similar small -> implausible vs real 70000-87000 -> FN on attendance thresholds.
game.Season INT -> Number fuzzer: fresh draws in [-10^scale,10^scale] (scale 0 -> [-1,1]) plus perturb -> years 2007-2011 never reproduced -> FN on Season filters.

FK consistency: game.stadium_id drawn from stadium.id final values, injury_accident.game_id from game.id — joins preserved, so join-count queries survive; but parent PK filtering may shrink parent set -> some child rows dropped or NULL.
No NOT NULL/CHECK: rows violating nothing (all nullable) so insert rarely fails; but PK dupes dropped -> row counts shrink vs original -> COUNT(*) queries differ -> FP/FN.
Ties/duplicates: original has ties (Home_team 3 distinct over 20 rows, Score 11 distinct) — TS fresh draws rarely reproduce exact tie structure -> queries with GROUP BY/HAVING or 'top-k' -> FP.
